newsitem.title: FRANCE: MATIF Bobl future, option start trading May 16.
newsitem.headline: MATIF Bobl future, option start trading May 16.

text.p: French futures and options exchange MATIF will launch its new BOBL option contracts and underlying BOBL future on May 16 at 0630 GMT, MATIF said on Wednesday.
CDC Marche, CPR, Societe Generale and Transoptions Finance will be designated market makers for the BOBL option. They are all currently market makers in French bond options traded on MATIF.
The four institutions will offer continuous prices with a bid/offer spread of less than 10 basis points for orders of 50 lots or more, MATIF said in a statement.
The BOBL future will start trading on GLOBEX at 0500 GMT from May 19 while the option will first be quoted on GLOBEX on July 8.
